text:
Which statement describes an advantage of using a hydrogen–oxygen fuel cell in a car compared
to a gasoline engine?
A
The hydrogen is difficult to store.
B
The hydrogen is highly flammable.
C
The hydrogen used is made from hydrocarbons.
D
The only chemical product is water.

options.label: A
options.text: The hydrogen is difficult to store.

options.label: C
options.text: The hydrogen used is made from hydrocarbons.

options.label: D
options.text: The only chemical product is water.
